editorial.blurb: A Chicago favorite that masterfully blends creative sushi and wok dishes with genuinely fresh ingredients and accessible prices—the kind of place you'll want to visit again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for lunch on a weekday for shorter waits and a lively casual vibe; don't miss the signature dragon roll and tonkotsu ramen, which reviewers consistently rave about.
